title: Passport.app
description:
Passport.app is the new way to manage your passport.  Safely store your passport on your phone for secure access on-the-go. Keep track of expiry dates and save money by avoiding expensive last-minute renewals.

Features:
- Store your Passports on Your Mobile Device:  Save multiple passports and identity documents to use when you’re on-the-go.
- No more surcharges:  Get a reminder when your passport needs to be renewed and save money on late fees or surcharges. 
- Guarantee peace of mind: No more travel nightmares or mishaps for you or your family.
- Your identity safely at your fingertips: Your Passport is stored in your mobile device's secure area - think of it like a safe on your phone.
- Capture your e-Passport biometric chip data.
- Easily share your details, on your terms: Total control over what information you want to share, with whom and when.

Passport.app is Swiss-made software and a product of Travizory Border Security SA.

title: TravelPassport
description:
Travel without the friction.

TravelPassport brings all your plans into one place
and turns them into a ready-to-use itinerary.

From a simple idea, AI organizes your trip,
combining flights, hotels, and activities into one clear plan.
Everything you need is right there when you need it.

---

What you can do:

• Turn ideas into a structured itinerary instantly  
• Keep flights, hotels, and plans in one place  
• Access tickets and details in seconds  
• Stay organized throughout your trip  
• Share your plans with friends and family  

---

Spend less time figuring things out,
and more time enjoying the journey.

TravelPassport helps you stay focused on what matters — the trip itself.

title: Stample: Travel Passport
description:
Stample turns travelling into something you keep.

Every city has places worth the detour. The bakery locals queue for, the viewpoint that never makes the postcards, the bar down an alley you would walk straight past. Stample maps them, and gives you a reason to actually go.

FIND SPOTS WORTH THE DETOUR
Open the map and see what is around you, filtered by what you are in the mood for: food, cafes, culture, nature, nightlife, viewpoints. Every spot is checked before it goes on the map, so you are not scrolling past the same ten tourist traps.

STAMP IT, ON LOCATION
You have to be there. Stample confirms you are actually standing at a spot before it gives you the stamp. That is the whole point: a full passport means something.

BUILD A TRAVEL PASSPORT
Your stamps collect into a passport that grows city by city. Earn stickers and badges along the way, level up as you explore, and look back on where you have been without scrolling through a camera roll.

COMPARE WITH FRIENDS
Follow people, see who has covered more of a city, and put your passports side by side. Monthly challenges give everyone something to chase.

SAVE PLACES FOR LATER
Keep lists of the spots you want to hit, sorted by city, so your next trip half plans itself.

MAKE ALBUMS
Turn a trip into an album of your own photos and share it as a single card.

STAMPLE INSIDER
Insider is optional. Finding spots, stamping them and building your passport are all free, forever. Insider adds passport customisation, deeper stats and a few extras for people who want them.

Stample is built by a small team and gets better every month. If something is missing, tell us: team@stample.world

title: Polarsteps
description: Plan, track and relive your adventures with Polarsteps. Keep your friends and family up to date. Whether it’s a six-month trip or a weekend canoeing close to home, Polarsteps is here to capture and share your journeys as they unfold. PLAN ■ AI itinerary planner: Create a personalized adventure based on past trips or current goals. ■ Destination snapshots: Get a quick overview of each place, why it fits your travel style, and which friends have already been there. ■ Trip details: Add notes, accommodation details, and must-see spots and activities. ■ Transport planner: Choose how you'll get from A to B for every leg of the trip. ■ Inspiration: Follow other explorers, see where they went, and get ideas for your own trips. TRACK ■ Automatic route tracking: Accurately track the route you took on a beautiful digital world map. ■ Travel Buddies: Invite friends to track trips together. ■ Capture the adventure: Add photos, videos, and stories to each step to bring your journey to life. ■ Travel stats: See how much of the world you’ve traveled, with your total of countries visited, distances covered, and more. ■ Top spots: Add your favorite places and activities so they’re part of your story. ■ Transport mode: Select how you got from place to place, whether by plane, train, or even tuk tuk. SHARE ■ Trip updates: Share your journey so friends and family can follow along from anywhere, seeing where you are and what you’ve been up to. ■ Traveler tips: Leave suggestions for other travelers on what to see and do. ■ Privacy controls: Decide who sees your adventures: everyone, followers only, or you only. RELIVE ■ Digital memories: Scroll through the places, photos, stories, and stats you’ve captured across all your trips. ■ Trip Reels: With the press of a button, transform your trip into a memorable video (also perfect to share on socials). ■ Travel Books: Turn your trip into a beautifully printed Travel Book that showcases your route and memories. WHAT OUR USERS SAY: “Love this app! It tracks me on my vacation and provides real-time notifications to friends and family of my trip. At the end, I ordered a Travel Book of my photos which is very high quality.” “The Polarsteps app is great. I am totally addicted. It is so nice to keep up with all your travels. And friends and family can follow you wherever you go. The Travel Book, which you can order afterwards, is of very good quality.” “I’ve been using this app for years now. It’s always been good and it keeps getting better.” WHAT THE PRESS ARE SAYING ABOUT POLARSTEPS “The Polarsteps app replaces your travel journal, making it easier and more beautiful.” - National Geographic “Polarsteps helps you track and share your journeys in an easy and visually appealing way” - The Next Web “Polarsteps’ resulting travel log is impressive, and is the source of a severe case of itchy feet in your correspondent.” - TechCrunch

title: Stampway: Travel Passport
description:
Every trip deserves to be remembered. Every border you cross and every new country you visit leaves a mark that goes far beyond a simple stamp.

Stampway is your digital travel passport. When you travel, you collect stories. Stampway keeps them.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Collect digital stamps: create a visual record each time you cross a border and personalize it with the date, the place and your travel notes.
• Your digital passport: see your whole travel history and every country you've visited in one place.
• Share your adventures: show your collection to family and friends and tell the story behind each trip.
• Personal stats: how many countries you've visited, your first stamp and your next destination.
• Cloud sync: your stamps are saved, so you can switch phones without losing them.

Stampway is free, with an optional Pro subscription.

Stampway is an app by iziapps.

title: Stamps: Visa Day Tracker
description:
Stamps counts the days you have left in every visa regime you travel under, and warns you before you run out.

Most day counters do Schengen and stop there. Stamps knows that the UK counts per visit, that the US counts from the date an officer wrote on your I-94, and that a short hop to Canada does not reset your ESTA clock. Each trip is counted by the rule that actually applies to it, based on your passport.

SIX REGIMES, ONE APP
• Schengen Area: 90 days in any rolling 180
• Türkiye: the same 90/180 window for visa-exempt visitors
• United Kingdom: up to 6 months per visit
• United States: ESTA 90-day admissions, or the admit-until date stamped in your passport
• Canada: officer-stamped visitor admissions
• Mexico: FMM days as written by the INM officer

PLAN BEFORE YOU BOOK
Try a trip before you pay for it. Stamps tells you whether it fits and how many days you will have left afterwards. If it does not fit, it suggests a shorter stay or a later start that does. Stack up to four trips to see how they add up together.

SEE WHEN YOU CAN GO
The calendar shades every empty day by how long a trip starting there could last. Green means a fortnight fits. Long-press one to try it.

YOUR VISA, NOT THE DEFAULT
Enter the visa you were actually issued and the count uses your allowance. Someone granted 30 days has 30, and an app that shows them 90 is walking them into an overstay.

KNOW YOUR OWN PATTERN
When you travel, how long you go for, how long you stay home between trips, and what it all adds up to this year.

ON YOUR CALENDAR
Turn on calendar sync and your trips appear as all-day events in the calendar you choose, kept up to date as you edit them.

READY FOR THE BORDER
One tap gives you a full-screen, high-contrast summary an officer can read at arm's length. Export a PDF travel report for a visa application, or your whole history as CSV.

WORKS WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Everything works offline. Sign in only if you want your trips on more than one device.

NOT A GOVERNMENT APP
Stamps is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or acting on behalf of any government, immigration authority or border agency.

OFFICIAL SOURCES
Every rule Stamps applies comes from the authority that sets it, and each regime screen in the app links to its own source:
• Schengen Area: https://home-affairs.ec.europa.eu/policies/schengen/schengen-area_en
• Türkiye: https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa
• United Kingdom: https://www.gov.uk/standard-visitor
• United States, ESTA: https://www.cbp.gov/travel/international-visitors/esta
• United States, I-94 admissions: https://www.cbp.gov/travel/international-visitors/i-94-instructions
• Canada: https://ircc.canada.ca/english/helpcentre/answer.asp?qnum=1016
• Mexico, INM: https://www.inm.gob.mx/fmme/publico/en/solicitud.html

Stamps is a personal planning tool, not immigration advice and not an official record. The official count lives with border officers and government systems, and what they write overrides anything shown here. Check the destination's own source before you travel.

Free for 7 days or your first 3 trips. Stamps Pro unlocks unlimited trips, planning, insights and reminders.

title: Passaporama: Travel Stamp Map
description:
How much of the world have you seen? Passaporama shows it on a world map at night: every region you tick off lights up in the color of its part of the world, and every country gets its own stamp in your passport.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Tick off countries, regions and cities: 195 countries plus further territories, around 4,600 regions – states, provinces and the like – and more than 5,800 cities
• Tap to see a place, long-press to tick it off right away
• Four states per place: was there, lived there, passed through, want to go
• A date for every place – a year is enough – and a note
• The passport: every country gets its own stamp, the same one on every device
• On-site stamp: "Stamp here" finds your location once and sets the stamp – with a selfie if you like
• Photos and real passport stamps for every place
• Trips with dates and places – the app draws tracks from GPX and KML on the map and ticks off the places they touch, if you like
• Collector's Edition: your stamps in gold, sealing wax or brass
• Tick off districts, counties and municipalities – in Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the USA, the Netherlands, Portugal, Poland, Czechia and Brazil
• Year in review: your travel year as a picture story and as a video to share
• Badges for milestones, complete countries, capitals and more
• Compare with friends via QR code – no account, no server
• World map with roads and place names as a free download via Google Play – offline afterwards
• Statistics: countries out of 195, share of the world's land area, continents, regions, cities and capitals, plus progress per country
• Share your map with your numbers as an image
• Backup as a CSV file: save it and read it back in – a list of country codes can be read in as well
• App and place names in nine languages

WHY THIS APP
• The world map is built into the app and works without an internet connection
• Location only when you tap "Stamp here" – never in the background
• No account, no sign-in
• Your travels remain yours – backup and export at any time
• Smooth even on older devices

NOTE
Countries are the 193 members of the United Nations plus Vatican City and Palestine; further territories are counted separately. The map is schematic and makes no statement about sovereignty. Map data: Natural Earth, GeoNames, Wikidata; roads and places © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); districts and municipalities from official sources (credits in the app).

SUPPORT
Questions and feedback: jenssdroid.support@gmail.com

Privacy: the app processes your entries, trips, photos and locations only on your device; nothing reaches the provider. Only the optional QR scanner (Google Play services) sends diagnostic data to Google when you use it (see the privacy policy in this listing).

Made by jenssdroid.

title: Passeport de Voyage & Carte
description:
Ton passeport de voyage, ta carte du monde et tes albums photo, sur ton téléphone.
Un tampon par pays visité, une carte à cocher, un globe à faire tourner, et tes photos rangées par voyage.
Sans compte : tout reste chez toi.

POUR QUI
Pour qui compte ses pays, garde ses cartes d'embarquement dans une boîte et voudrait voir, d'un coup d'oeil, où il a mis les pieds. Tu coches un pays au retour, tu écris deux lignes, tu y reviens dans dix ans.

TON PASSEPORT
• Une page par pays, avec un tampon dessiné à la main et la silhouette du pays au centre.
• La date d'arrivée et la date de retour, écrites sur le tampon.
• Une photo par pays, collée sur la page comme un tirage, choisie en un geste dans l'album du voyage.
• Une note par pays : un plat, une rencontre, un moment.
• Une couverture à personnaliser : la couleur, l'ornement, ton prénom.
• Les pages se tournent du bout du doigt.

TES ALBUMS DE VOYAGE
• Souvenir range tes photos et tes vidéos en albums, tout seul : un album par voyage, avec le lieu et les dates.
• En haut, les drapeaux de tes pays ; en dessous, tes voyages classés par année.
• Ajoute une photo oubliée, retire celle qui n'a rien à faire là : rien n'est jamais effacé de ta galerie.
• Tout se passe sur ton téléphone : aucune photo n'est envoyée nulle part.

LA CARTE ET LE GLOBE
• La carte du monde : touche un pays pour le cocher, pince pour zoomer, glisse pour te promener, sans fin d'est en ouest.
• Un zoom qui descend jusqu'aux plus petites îles, avec le nom de chaque pays écrit sur la carte.
• Un globe en relief qui tourne sous le doigt, de la planète entière jusqu'aux îles des Caraïbes.
• Ton compteur : le nombre de pays et ton pourcentage du monde, sur les 195 pays reconnus.
• Les territoires s'affichent aussi sur la carte ; ils ne comptent pas dans les 195.
• Dans la liste, chaque pays porte son drapeau.

TES STATISTIQUES
• Ta progression continent par continent.
• Tes jours de voyage additionnés.
• 30 médailles à décrocher : de ton premier tampon à 150 pays, les six et les sept continents, l'Europe, l'Afrique, l'Asie, les Amériques et les mers du Sud, les îles, les pays sans mer, les micro-États, les quatre hémisphères, tes longs voyages, tes plus belles années, dix ans de voyages, et même tes photos et tes notes. Chacune arrive en grand, avec son animation.

SUR TON ÉCRAN D'ACCUEIL
Des widgets pour ton compteur de pays, ta carte du monde remplie et tes derniers pays avec leur drapeau.

À PARTAGER
Une image verticale au format 9:16, prête à poster.

CE QUE L'APP NE FAIT PAS
• Aucun compte à créer, aucun mot de passe.
• Tes pays, tes photos et tes notes restent sur ton téléphone, avec une sauvegarde dans ton propre compte Google. Personne d'autre n'y a accès.
• Tu peux exporter une sauvegarde complète et la réimporter quand tu veux.
• Seuls des rapports de plantage et une mesure d'audience anonyme nous aident à améliorer l'app, sans jamais voir tes photos ni tes lieux.
• Ce passeport est un souvenir, pas un document officiel : il ne remplace aucune pièce d'identité et ne donne droit à rien.

100 % gratuit. Pas d'abonnement, pas d'achat, pas de publicité.
Vingt langues, du français au japonais.

Infos et aide : https://simplibot.fr/souvenir

Ton passeport de voyage, ta carte du monde et tes albums photo, sur ton téléphone.
Un tampon par pays visité, une carte à cocher, un globe à faire tourner, et tes photos rangées par voyage.
Sans compte : tout reste chez toi.

POUR QUI
Pour qui compte ses pays, garde ses cartes d'embarquement dans une boîte et voudrait voir, d'un coup d'oeil, où il a mis les pieds. Tu coches un pays au retour, tu écris deux lignes, tu y reviens dans dix ans.

TON PASSEPORT
• Une page par pays, avec un tampon dessiné à la main et la silhouette du pays au centre.
• La date d'arrivée et la date de retour, écrites sur le tampon.
• Une photo par pays, collée sur la page comme un tirage, choisie en un geste dans l'album du voyage.
• Une note par pays : un plat, une rencontre, un moment.
• Une couverture à personnaliser : la couleur, l'ornement, ton prénom.
• Les pages se tournent du bout du doigt.

TES ALBUMS DE VOYAGE
• Souvenir range tes photos et tes vidéos en albums, tout seul : un album par voyage, avec le lieu et les dates.
• En haut, les drapeaux de tes pays ; en dessous, tes voyages classés par année.
• Ajoute une photo oubliée, retire celle qui n'a rien à faire là : rien n'est jamais effacé de ta galerie.
• Tout se passe sur ton téléphone : aucune photo n'est envoyée nulle part.

LA CARTE ET LE GLOBE
• La carte du monde : touche un pays pour le cocher, pince pour zoomer, glisse pour te promener, sans fin d'est en ouest.
• Un zoom qui descend jusqu'aux plus petites îles, avec le nom de chaque pays écrit sur la carte.
• Un globe en relief qui tourne sous le doigt, de la planète entière jusqu'aux îles des Caraïbes.
• Ton compteur : le nombre de pays et ton pourcentage du monde, sur les 195 pays reconnus.
• Les territoires s'affichent aussi sur la carte ; ils ne comptent pas dans les 195.
• Dans la liste, chaque pays porte son drapeau.

TES STATISTIQUES
• Ta progression continent par continent.
• Tes jours de voyage additionnés.
• 30 médailles à décrocher : de ton premier tampon à 150 pays, les six et les sept continents, l'Europe, l'Afrique, l'Asie, les Amériques et les mers du Sud, les îles, les pays sans mer, les micro-États, les quatre hémisphères, tes longs voyages, tes plus belles années, dix ans de voyages, et même tes photos et tes notes. Chacune arrive en grand, avec son animation.

SUR TON ÉCRAN D'ACCUEIL
Des widgets pour ton compteur de pays, ta carte du monde remplie et tes derniers pays avec leur drapeau.

À PARTAGER
Une image verticale au format 9:16, prête à poster.

• Seuls des rapports de plantage et une mesure d'audience anonyme nous aident à améliorer l'app, sans jamais voir tes photos ni tes lieux.
• Ce passeport est un souvenir, pas un document officiel : il ne remplace aucune pièce d'identité et ne donne droit à rien.

title: Stamp Quest
description:
Explore Japan Like Never Before with Stamp Quest!

Are you ready to embark on an exciting adventure across Japan? Stamp Quest is your ultimate travel companion, guiding you to discover unique Eki Stamps at train stations throughout the country. Perfect for tourists who love exploring Japanese culture, Stamp Quest transforms your journey into a memorable quest.

Key Features:
- Discover Eki Stamps: Find and collect unique Eki Stamps at various train stations across Japan.
- Interactive Map: Easily locate nearby Eki Stamps with our integrated Google Maps feature.

Why Eki Stamps?
Eki Stamps are more than just collectibles; they are a reflection of Japan's rich history and culture. Each stamp tells a unique story, representing the character of the station and its surrounding area. By collecting these stamps, you create lasting memories and explore the diverse and beautiful regions of Japan.

Join the Stamp Quest Community

Whether you are a seasoned traveler or visiting Japan for the first time, Stamp Quest will guide you in uncovering the hidden gems of Japan through Eki Stamps. Let's explore every part of Japan and make your journey unforgettable.

Download Stamp Quest today and start your adventure!

Terms of Use: https://www.thestampquest.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.thestampquest.com/privacy-policy
